description: Returns this month's Diagnostic allowance for the connected account: how many included Diagnostics are used (used), the monthly allowance (limit), how many remain (remaining), the plan, whose allowance a run draws on (pool), and the date the allowance resets (resets_on). On the Free plan it carries a note on the first-month allowance. With client_id, it also gives that client workspace's own monthly limit (per_client). Fits questions about how many Diagnostics are left this month and when the allowance resets.
name: get_usage
title: Get Diagnostic usage
